(other) 3509.02: any qualified elector may vote by absent voter's ballots (the bill replaces the list of excuse categories, such as age 62 or older and certain jobs)
(other) 3509.03, 3509.04, 3509.08: related absentee application and delivery wording; no ID text
(other) note: Only one version (introduced). No ID or citizenship text: a word search found only 'identification envelope'. Struck words are not marked in this PDF text.
(note) Off this topic: the bill sets no ID or citizenship-proof rule.
